entries.reason: BOTH halves, because both are true and a reader needs them together. FIRST: the name is the port's own, under a name no SDK header declares and no SDK surface contains - grep -c CharonMetalDevice coordination/corpus/sdk-26.2-surface.tsv is 0 - so NO RELEASE EVER CARRIES IT and that is why this row is about the release and not about the port. SECOND, which the row used to leave out: the port DOES build it, 27 methods, at packages/a/apple-backports/Metal/MTLSharedEvent12.m. The earlier row said only 'nothing is claimed to be built under this name', and that half was false
entries.effect: no release exports CharonMetalEventState and none ever did, so nothing in a band's inventory can answer the name and the row claims nothing about SDK behaviour with it. The port builds it as a stand-in for the MTL type, compiled hidden (xmake.lua:15 sets the package's -fvisibility=), so it is not exported either and could not be listed as implemented
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal, the header of MTLSharedEvent, whose API arrived in 12.0
